# Steve Hynding

> Resume and portfolio of Steve Hynding, Lead Full-Stack Engineer in Los
> Angeles — two decades shipping web products for EA, Sony, BCG Digital
> Ventures / BCG X, Pacaso, Jubilee Media and Superhuman.

## Resume

- [Resume (HTML)](https://hynding.github.io/): the canonical page, with
  schema.org Person structured data inline.
- [Resume (JSON Resume format)](https://hynding.github.io/resume.json):
  machine-readable, per the jsonresume.org schema.

Contact details and references are deliberately withheld from public copies
and are available on request.
